action_summary: Measures the owner's claim that solved instant learning implies solved computer use. Census at base: 943 of 2592 tracked test files (36.38%) are pytest-shaped, and `python -m unittest` runs 0 tests and exits 0 on them; two were run both ways (unittest 0/OK; pytest 10 and 4 passed). Main PR #6836 landed the vacuity guard concurrently, so the duplicate module written here was DELETED and main's kept. The surviving defect is collector reachability: main's bounded env hides an installed pytest, so the fallback is unreachable and the check is discarded as CHECK_NO_DISCOVERABLE_TESTS. Appending the caller's existing PYTHONPATH dirs AFTER the project copy makes the same check available, accepting the original and refusing a broken `return None` edit. Also audits five durable experience stores against the ASCENT/Experience-Distillation training-signal contract: 0/71 rows admissible, 0 stores record a failure. Claims no capability, flips no family, moves no benchmark.
expected_parent_change: A pytest-shaped project's own tests are reachable as the check, so the vacuity guard's fallback runs instead of discarding the check; the project copy stays first on PYTHONPATH.
expected_parent_frontier_change: Real checks are no longer discarded because the collector was installed outside the project copy. No capability is registered and no family is flipped.
falsification_condition: The repaired env lets the repository's own modules satisfy a project's suite, the check accepts a broken edit, a genuinely passing unittest project is refused, or an existing consumer regresses.
stop_condition: The broken-edit counterfactual is refused and the passing controls are accepted; 24 new tests pass; the two existing consumer suites and the compatibility four suites add no new failure; the unified verifier passes 33/33; repo-integrity static passes; the required referee is green; no capability, family, benchmark or terminal credit is claimed.
explicit_user_authorization: PARAPHRASE, NOT A QUOTATION. On 2026-11-12 the owner narrowed this round to Problem 2 -- a similar task must be adaptable, not only an exact repeat -- and asked for it solved perfectly in the fastest way, with the real limiting factor found from first principles, bad ideas killed before implementation, and a standing instruction to push and merge the work. No merge of governance, no change to any law, no credit requested or claimed. $0 spend, zero model calls in the producer path, no sentience claim.
